author: Zoro2024
raw_text:
Poor Customer Service: I have been an Amazon Prime member for many years on both Amazon UAE and Amazon UK, and this is the first time I have felt genuinely let down by Amazon.
I ordered Sony WH-1000XM6 headphones in Silver, but Amazon delivered the Black version instead. The mistake was entirely Amazon’s, yet I have been left to deal with the consequences.
The item was collected for return immediately. Before the collection, I contacted customer service twice and was assured that my refund to my Amazon Gift Card balance would be processed as soon as the parcel was picked up. That information proved to be incorrect. Days later, I am still waiting for my refund and have been told I may have to wait until Amazon receives the item at its return centre.

To make matters worse, I received an “Incident Report” through the Amazon app requesting information that customers cannot realistically provide. It asks me to reply to an email that was never sent and to provide a return tracking number that is not displayed anywhere in the app. 
Customer service repeatedly tells me to “fill in the report” without explaining how or where to submit it. No submission window and the report which was in the message centre is a screenshot and one cannot type on the allocated space.

What is most disappointing is not the delay itself, but the decline in customer service. It has become increasingly difficult to reach someone who takes ownership of a problem. Instead of resolving the issue, I was repeatedly passed between departments and given inconsistent information.

I purchased these headphones specifically for an upcoming flight. Because Amazon shipped the wrong item and delayed the refund, I was unable to purchase the correct headphones before travelling.

I have always regarded Amazon as a company that set the benchmark for customer service. Unfortunately, this experience has seriously damaged my confidence in Amazon UAE
claude_summary: Detailed complaint about poor customer service, incorrect delivery, and issues with a return refund.
